items.text: Refined extraction mission interactions: movement and camera lock during hold‑E actions, progress resets on cancellation, ledger and maintenance reads now take five seconds and only consume repair materials after completion.
Added initial loot item appearance and a loot‑reveal step for extraction missions.
Introduced scout drones that patrol small monuments, emit a 4‑second flashing/beeping wind‑up, can be dodged, deal 55 damage with mid‑fight strikes, and raise alarms when they detect players.
Drones now have a visible search light, a health pool, and perform active searches, adding new combat and detection dynamics.
Outpost is no longer placed on the raid map, keeping it separate from raid navigation.
After each raid the hub map is cleared and the safe‑pocket counts toward the player's carried inventory limit.
Loot items are now priced according to their type; furniture has its own contents and blueprints now have weight, affecting carry limits.
Supplies shop prices increased, every item now has a defined value, and loot drops prioritize higher‑tier gear over crafted items.
Each enemy type, including monument guards, now drops its own specific reward tier, and guard loot is tier‑based.
Raids cannot be started without a proper raid map, preventing crashes and error states.
Hotbar now displays action progress for abilities and reloads, giving clearer feedback on ongoing actions.
Extraction balloons now display a timer and close sequentially.
Outpost added to the extraction map.
More monuments placed on the extraction map.
New 3 km procedural map scene introduced for extraction raids.
Extracted loot is banked in a stash and raiders are dropped at raid start.
Main inventory size on the extraction map halved.
Items now have a scrap value and loot worth is displayed.
Safe pocket shown next to any looted container.
Players can no longer deploy while crafting.
Reload bar displayed beside the weapon in shoulder camera view.
Fixed first‑person turn‑in‑place rotation being applied twice per frame, eliminating pop‑in artifacts.
Resolved null reference error in the water wheel menu.
Fixed edge‑case rotation errors for swimming NPCs and simple sharks.
Fixed terrain clipping over doorways and underground tunnels at the Nuclear Missile Silo.
Fixed issues where railway tracks could be buried by terrain or covered by shore ice.
Fixed a bug where the CH47 crate could land on top of powerline poles at the Power Plant.
Fixed several issues with explosion screen shake, screen bounce fading, and the explosions overlay not resetting properly.
Fixed a bug in the Vending Machine admin UI where the 'Remove All' popup could not be interacted with.
Added the Bradley APC boss mission set in an abandoned military base with data‑driven mission names.
Increased bow damage (stronger bow).
Enabled free invites for players.
Loadout changes now allow redressing a single soldier without cancelling ongoing jobs.
Injured soldiers will now rest on their own without player intervention.
Recycler can now be reached and interacted with in 3D space; it reveals as a drop‑in and bursts out when used.
Outside walks now route around the base instead of getting stuck.
Build guides are shown only while actively building, reducing UI clutter.
Resource bar enlarged and a bottom‑left log added for better visibility of resources and events.

2026-11-16.summary: No notable player-facing changes were identified in the latest development commits.

### Raiding

### NPC & AI

### Loot & UI
